From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@atlashealth.com>

Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Date: 2026-11-30T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Annual invoicing approach — AtlasHealth PO and VAT questions

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the quick call earlier. Procurement asked me to consolidate a single plan for how Redwood will invoice against our committed spend for 2027 across jurisdictions. The main asks from our side:

- A clear waterfall (priority order) for how monthly drawdowns / quarterly invoices will apply against our prepayment balance and remaining committed credits.
- Country-by-country VAT treatment (we have entities in US, UK, DE, and NL). Is Redwood planning to issue gross invoices with VAT, or will reverse-charge apply in some cases?
- Process for carrying over unused credits at quarter/year boundary (we need an audit trail for our finance team).

I've attached our PO (PO-57823.pdf) — can you confirm the invoice cadence you recommend and any documentation your tax team needs?

Best,
Maria Lopez
Sr. Procurement Manager
AtlasHealth

Attachment: PO-57823.pdf (application/pdf)

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@atlashealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-01T09:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Invoice waterfall plan + country VAT matrix — draft attached

Hi Maria —

Thanks, and appreciate the PO. I pulled together a draft invoice waterfall and a proposed cadence for drawdowns (attached). High-level summary below:

- Invoice waterfall (priority):
  1) Monthly drawdown invoices applied to committed prepay balance (reduces prepay pool)
  2) Quarterly reconciliation invoices for overage/under-consumption (positive/negative)
  3) Year-end sweep invoice adjusting final balances and documenting carry-forwards

- Credit rollover: unused monthly drawdowns roll into the quarterly reconciliation bucket. Any remaining credits at year-end are either: (a) rolled forward with an audit line item and expiry date, or (b) refunded per the contract clause (we default to rollover unless finance requests a refund).

- VAT approach (draft):
  - US entity: no VAT; Redwood will supply gross USD invoices.
  - UK: Redwood will issue invoices with VAT where applicable. We will need AtlasHealth VAT registration number for UK sales.
  - Germany (DE): likely reverse-charge for B2B services; we will confirm with tax.
  - Netherlands (NL): similar to DE — need VAT reg and local PO/contract notes.

Action items for AtlasHealth:
- Share VAT registration numbers for UK/DE/NL and preferred PO reference mapping to PO-57823.
- Confirm whether you prefer monthly netting (we invoice net usage monthly) or quarterly netting (one consolidated reconciliation).

I've attached invoice_waterfall_v3.xlsx (draft) — internal finance (Rishi, Ben) can you review the GL codes and VAT columns?

Camila Reyes
Account Lead, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachment: invoice_waterfall_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Camila — quick notes from finance after a first pass: 

- GL mapping: please use revenue code 4102 for hosted inference usage and 4201 for reserved/dedicated capacity — I'll flag these on the spreadsheet.
- VAT: Germany and NL look like reverse-charge in most cases for B2B; Ben and I attached a compact VAT matrix with flags per country and sample invoice lines. See vat_country_matrix_AtlasHealth.pdf attached.
- Netting cadence: finance prefers monthly netting for less reconciliation overhead. If AtlasHealth's AP team wants quarterly for their cycle, we can support that but will need an explicit reconciliation window and a signed mutual action plan.

Ben — if you can add wire instructions and whether we need a separate remittance advice per invoice that would help.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra

Hi Maria —

Following internal review I've consolidated the approach below and attached the final artifacts. This will be our operational playbook for 2027 invoicing and drawdown handling unless you request changes: 

Final plan (summary):
- Monthly drawdown invoices posted on the 5th business day for the prior month, applied directly to PO-57823 prepay pool.
- Quarterly reconciliation (end of Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) to account for overage/under-consumption with a detailed line-by-line audit file.
- Year-end sweep (first week of January) to export final balances and either roll forward credits (default) or process refunds per signed request.
- VAT: Redwood will issue gross invoices where local VAT applies. For DE/NL we will include a reverse-charge note when applicable — please send VAT IDs for each entity and indicate which entity will be the billing recipient.

Attachments included: invoice_waterfall_v3.xlsx, vat_country_matrix_AtlasHealth.pdf

Requests / action items for AtlasHealth:
1) Confirm VAT numbers and billing entity by 2026-12-15.
2) Confirm monthly or quarterly netting preference for AP. If monthly, we will proceed with the cadence above. If quarterly, we'll prepare a short mutual action plan and a reconciliation SLA.
3) Accept the invoice waterfall via DocuSign so finance can lock the cadence and our billing ops can set up automated drawdowns: https://redwood.app/docusign/HS-2345678
